Wait — careful about a few things:
1. vanilla reads collideX/collideY (from previous tick's collision). Ours reads this.hitWall etc. AFTER moveAndCollide — currently the code reads them after the move (post-move flags). To preserve that pattern (which other repo AIs use), the reflection applies to NEXT tick's velocity — matching vanilla's next-tick AI read. But ordering matters for the shared integration: vanilla AI tick N: reflect → gravity → integrate. Ours: (post-move flags from tick N) → reflect → done; integrate happens in moveAndCollide at... hmm — our moveAndCollide is the integration. Sequence per tick: steering → moveAndCollide (integrate + set flags) → reflection read flags → adjust velocity for next tick. Equivalent to vanilla (one tick delayed reaction either way). Keep the current pattern.

2. But the reflection uses `spd = |velocity|` at that moment — after our velocity adjustments. Vanilla: velocity = angleDir × velocity.Length() — the length of the CURRENT velocity (post damping/thrust this tick). Ours computes after this tick's thrust — same relative timing as vanilla? Vanilla AI at tick N reflects using velocity AFTER thrust/damp of tick N (velocity was modified by AI first, reflection at end of AI). Ours: thrust/damp → moveAndCollide (zeroes blocked axes! vanilla doesn't zero — TileCollision DOES zero blocked velocity in vanilla too — yes vanilla TileCollision zeroes velocity on block). Hmm — so |velocity| after collision could be 0 (fully blocked) → reflected velocity = 0. Vanilla: same (velocity zeroed by TileCollision at end of tick N; reflection at tick N+1 reads direction from ai[0]... no wait — vanilla reflection at tick N+1: velocity.Length() = 0 if fully blocked → velocity stays 0 but ai[0] still flipped. Then thrust +0.06 along new angle rebuilds speed. Fine — equivalent.

3. `flag2` in vanilla: `collideY && wet && (!flag || velocity.Y < 0f)`. collideY = any Y collision. Ours: onGround || hitHead ✓.

4. The wet check: vanilla `wet` — ours: this.wet (collision box) ✓ (the old code used center-tile liquid>80 — fix).

5. rotation: vanilla sets rotation each wet tick = vx*0.1; dry: rotation += (vx+vy)/2*0.05. Our visAngle ✓.

6. nearSurface: `flag = waterLineHeight > 0 && base.Top.Y - waterLineHeight < 20f` — Top.Y = this.y ✓.

7. GetWaterLineIterate quirk: `waterLineHeight = Y * 16; waterLineHeight -= Main.tile[X, Y - 1].liquid / 16;` — uses Y-1's liquid (int division, not float). Port: `iy * TILE - Math.trunc(liquid(iy-1) / 16)`.

Edge: itx out of bounds — st.idx would be garbage; guard inBounds.

8. noGravity = wet — our applyGravity reads this.wet for the gravity tier; when wet we skip gravity entirely (vanilla noGravity). ✓ my code does `if (!wet) applyGravity`.

One question: dry branch order — vanilla: `if (!wet) {...}` comes FIRST (before wet thrust). Mine matches.

 "new_string": "  /** AI_118 海马 626/627（AI_118_Seahorses cs:47432-47486）1:1：noGravity=wet；\n   *  GetWaterLineIterate（Collision.cs:1554-1573）向上迭代找液面 → 贴皮 flag =\n   *  液面有效且 Top 距液面 <20。湿：ai[1] 归零时沿 ai[0] 角 +0.06 推进，合速 >3 →\n   *  vx 钳 ±3（仅 X，:47454）+ 重掷计时 450-600 + 随机角（贴皮且新角朝上 θ>π →\n   *  θ−π 折返压回水下，:47457-47460）；非推进帧 v×0.95；rotation = vx×0.1。\n   *  干：vy==0 时 vx×0.95 瘫软 + rotation += (vx+vy)/2×0.05。碰撞角反射\n   *  （:47470-47485）：collideX → 角向量 X 取反；collideY（湿且(非贴皮|上升中)）→\n   *  Y 取反；velocity = 新角向 × 原速率（保速换向） */\n  private seahorseAI(game: GameHooks) {\n    const st = game.world.store;\n    // 类默认 -1120 当角度用 = 出生朝向固化 ~92°(2026-08-13 清查)——归 0 与 NewNPC\n    // ai[]=0 一致：角 0(朝东)，首帧 ai[1]=0−1≤0 即 +0.06 推进直到 >3 才掷随机角\n    //（原版无\"==0 掷随机角\"自愈——曾自创，审计 15.2 残余,2026-08-19）\n    if (this.ai0 < 0) this.ai0 = 0;\n    // GetWaterLineIterate：中心列自中心格逐行上行越过液柱，回退一格；该格有液 →\n    // 线 = 行×16 − trunc(上一格液量/16)（cs:1557-1571 原式即用 Y−1 格液量）\n    const itx = Math.floor(this.cx / TILE);\n    let iy = Math.floor(this.cy / TILE);\n    while (iy > 0 && st.inBounds(itx, iy) && st.liquid[st.idx(itx, iy)] > 0) iy--;\n    iy++;\n    let waterLine = 0;\n    if (st.inBounds(itx, iy) && st.liquid[st.idx(itx, iy)] > 0) {\n      const up = st.inBounds(itx, iy - 1) ? st.liquid[st.idx(itx, iy - 1)] : 0;\n      waterLine = iy * TILE - Math.trunc(up / 16);\n    }\n    const nearSurface = waterLine > 0 && this.y - waterLine < 20;   // flag（:47436）\n    const wet = this.wet;    // noGravity = wet（:47434）；水中判据 = 碰撞盒 wet\n    if (!wet) {\n      if (this.vy === 0) this.vx *= 0.95;\n      this.visAngle += ((this.vx + this.vy) / 2) * 0.05;            // rotation（:47443）\n    } else {\n      this.ai1 -= 1;\n      if (this.ai1 <= 0) {\n        this.vx += Math.cos(this.ai0) * 0.06;\n        this.vy += Math.sin(this.ai0) * 0.06;\n        if (Math.hypot(this.vx, this.vy) > 3) {\n          this.vx = Math.min(3, Math.max(-3, this.vx));             // 仅 X 钳 ±3（:47454）\n          this.ai1 = 450 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 150);\n          this.ai0 = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;\n          // 贴水皮且新角朝上（θ∈(π,2π)）→ θ−π 掉头压回水下（:47457-47460）\n          if (nearSurface && this.ai0 > Math.PI) this.ai0 -= Math.PI;\n        }\n      } else {\n        this.vx *= 0.95;\n        this.vy *= 0.95;\n      }\n      this.visAngle = this.vx * 0.1;                                // rotation（:47468）\n    }\n    // 角反射（:47470-47485，读上一 tick collideX/collideY——本仓 moveAndCollide 旗标）\n    const reflectY = (this.onGround || this.hitHead) && wet && (!nearSurface || this.vy < 0);\n    if (this.hitWall || reflectY) {\n      let rx = Math.cos(this.ai0), ry = Math.sin(this.ai0);\n      if (this.hitWall) rx = -rx;\n      if (reflectY) ry = -ry;\n      this.ai0 = Math.atan2(ry, rx);\n      const spd = Math.hypot(this.vx, this.vy);\n      this.vx = Math.cos(this.ai0) * spd;\n      this.vy = Math.sin(this.ai0) * spd;\n    }\n    this.facing = this.vx > 0 ? 1 : -1;\n    if (!wet) this.applyGravity(game);   // noGravity = wet 的本仓等价（干侧重力）\n    moveAndCollide(this, game.world, this.vx, this.vy);\n  }"

Hmm — wait. I wrote something convoluted for the flee vector. Let me reconsider the vanilla math:

```
zero = Vector2.Zero;
for each threat within range: zero += DirectionFrom(threat.Center)   // unit vector pointing FROM threat TO me
if count > 0:
    zero /= count;       // average of unit vectors
    zero *= 2f;          // scale 2
    velocity += zero;
    clamp 16
    anchor = Center + zero*10
```

So zero = (Σ unit_i) / count × 2. My implementation did something weird (normalizing first then n2/count...). That's NOT equivalent. Let me redo it simply: accumulate unit vectors (ux, uy); then zero = (ux/count)*2, (uy/count)*2. My "zx/zy" accumulation of raw deltas is unused garbage. Let me clean that up — rewrite the flee block properly.

Options: skip spriteDir (visual only, note it) — the existing code didn't have it either. I'll note "spriteDirection 渲染翻转未接" like before (备案 was already there). Actually — wait, I could store it in... there's no spriteDir field. Leave noted.

Movement integration: crawl state velocity (spd*direction, spd*directionY) then moveAndCollide — vanilla uses shared integration + MoveSnailOnSlopes. Our moveAndCollide handles slopes.

Now — one important ordering thing: the state machine reads collideX/collideY from the PREVIOUS tick (vanilla). In our pattern: moveAndCollide at the END of the AI; the flags read at the START next tick. But the current repo snail code has no moveAndCollide in crawl state (raw x += vx) — that's the "无碰撞积分(沉地)" bug. My port: read flags at top (from last tick), then compute, then moveAndCollide.

Let me now also handle the panic-state `collideY` read: vanilla reads the flag (last tick). Ours: read this.onGround||this.hitHead at the top of the AI (which hold last tick's values since moveAndCollide sets them at the end of the previous tick... wait no — our flags are set DURING moveAndCollide at end of previous AI call → they persist into this tick's AI ✓).

Probe A: `int num1056 = (int)(base.Center.X + (float)(width / 2 * -direction)) / 16;` — hmm: (Center.X + w/2*-direction) then /16 (int division of positive value → floor). Port: Math.floor((this.cx + (this.w / 2 * -this.facing)) / TILE). Hmm — `width / 2 * -direction` — int width/2 then float mult ✓.
`num1057 = (int)(position.Y + height + 8) / 16` → floor((this.y + this.h + 8)/TILE).
`if (tile != null && !topSlope() && collideY) ai[2] -= 1` — collideY = LAST TICK flag. 

Probe B: `num1057 = (int)(position.Y + height - 4)/16; num1056 = (int)(Center.X + w/2*direction)/16; if bottomSlope() → direction *= -1`. bottomSlope = slope 3|4.

Let me also check TileStore slope encoding: st.slope values 0-4 (1=left-high,2=right-high,3=left-low(ceiling),4=right-low). topSlope = 1|2; bottomSlope = 3|4.

 "new_string": "  /** AI_064 萤火虫族（cs:34256-34485）1:1：ai[0]/ai[1]=漂移目标速度（localAI[0] 计时\n   *  60-179，本仓以 ai[2] 承接）；ai[3]=scale（Next(75,111)×0.01）。\n   *  漂移重选（:34267-34304）：|ΔX|>700 且 localAI[3]==0 → 【远距构型】方向×\n   *  Next(100,251) + Y Next(−50,51)（在玩家下方 100px 再 −Next(100,251)），归一 ×\n   *  三档速（>1000：1.5-2.0 / >850：1.0-1.5 / 其余 0.5-1.5）——曾随机角近似；\n   *  否则 → localAI[3]=1（此后恒近距构型）+ ±100/±100 分量归一 × Next(5,151)×0.01。\n   *  677 仙尘（:34307-34389）：世界缘 40 格内推离（分量 ±0.5 钳 ±3）+ 逃逸（15t 门）\n   *  对【实际速度】叠加 Σ单位向/count×2 钳 8，并把 localAI[0] 置 10（强制重选）。\n   *  闪烁（:34391-34423）：localAI[2] 发光倒计 / localAI[1] 暗间隔 30-180；\n   *  !白天或地下（y>worldSurface+10）才亮 10-30 帧。\n   *  平滑 v=(v×79+目标)/80；垂直避障：vy>0 中心列 [cy,cy+4) 逐格（实心/液 → 翻 ai1\n   *  +vy×0.9，无 break）；vy<0 [cy,cy+30) 无实心 → 同款；collideX → 目标翻离墙侧\n   *  + vx×−0.2。677 rotation = vx×0.3（:47473 同段） */\n  private fireflyAI(game: GameHooks, player: Player | null) {\n    const st = game.world.store;\n    const isFaeling = this.vanillaId === 677;\n    if (!this.aiInit) {\n      this.aiInit = true;\n      this.ai0 = 0; this.ai1 = 0; this.ai2 = 0;\n      // 随机 scale 0.75-1.10（ai[3] = Next(75,111)×0.01，:34263-34266）\n      this.ai3 = (75 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 36)) * 0.01;\n      this.vanillaScale = this.ai3;\n    }\n    let n0 = this.ai0, n1 = this.ai1;   // num1022/num1023（先写局部再回存，:34258-34259）\n    // ---- 漂移目标重选（localAI[0] 计时，:34262-34304）----\n    this.ai2 -= 1;\n    if (this.ai2 <= 0) {\n      // TargetClosest（direction 朝玩家侧——远距构型用）\n      let dir = this.facing;\n      if (player && !player.dead) dir = player.cx >= this.cx ? 1 : -1;\n      this.facing = dir;\n      this.ai2 = 60 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 120);\n      const dx = player ? Math.abs(player.cx - this.cx) : 0;\n      if (dx > 700 && this.lai3 === 0) {\n        // 远距构型（:34272-34292）：三档速 + direction×Next(100,251) + Y 分量\n        let spd = (50 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 101)) * 0.01;\n        if (dx > 1000) spd = (150 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 51)) * 0.01;\n        else if (dx > 850) spd = (100 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 51)) * 0.01;\n        const vx0 = dir * (100 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 151));\n        let vy0 = -50 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 101);\n        if (player && this.y > player.y - 100) vy0 -= 100 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 151);\n        const inv = spd / Math.hypot(vx0, vy0);\n        n0 = vx0 * inv;\n        n1 = vy0 * inv;\n      } else {\n        // 近距构型（:34293-34302）：localAI[3]=1 锁定（此后不再走远距）；±100 分量\n        this.lai3 = 1;\n        const spd = (5 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 146)) * 0.01;\n        const vx0 = -100 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 201);\n        const vy0 = -100 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 201);\n        const inv = spd / Math.hypot(vx0, vy0);\n        n0 = vx0 * inv;\n        n1 = vy0 * inv;\n      }\n    }\n    if (isFaeling) {\n      // ---- 677 世界缘推离（:34307-34347：Center 格 40 格内推离，分量 += 0.5 钳 ±3）----\n      let offEdge = true;\n      const px4 = Math.floor(this.cx / TILE), py4 = Math.floor(this.cy / TILE);\n      if (px4 < 40) { n0 += 0.5; if (n0 > 3) n0 = 3; offEdge = false; }\n      else if (px4 > st.w - 40) { n0 -= 0.5; if (n0 < -3) n0 = -3; offEdge = false; }\n      if (py4 < 40) { n1 += 0.5; if (n1 > 3) n1 = 3; offEdge = false; }\n      else if (py4 > st.h - 40) { n1 -= 0.5; if (n1 < -3) n1 = -3; offEdge = false; }\n      // ---- 677 逃逸（localAI[1] 15t 门；世界缘时不扫，:34348-34389）----\n      if (this.lai1 > 0) {\n        this.lai1 -= 1;\n      } else if (offEdge) {\n        this.lai1 = 15;\n        let count = 0, ux = 0, uy = 0;\n        const boxDist = (b: { x: number; y: number; w: number; h: number }): number => {\n          const qx = Math.max(b.x, Math.min(this.cx, b.x + b.w));\n          const qy = Math.max(b.y, Math.min(this.cy, b.y + b.h));\n          return Math.hypot(this.cx - qx, this.cy - qy);\n        };\n        for (const o of game.enemies()) {\n          const e = o as Enemy;\n          if (e === this || e.dead || e.def.damage <= 0 || e.def.friendly) continue;\n          if (boxDist(e) <= 100) {\n            const d = Math.hypot(this.cx - e.cx, this.cy - e.cy) || 1;\n            count++; ux += (this.cx - e.cx) / d; uy += (this.cy - e.cy) / d;\n          }\n        }\n        const pp: Player | null = (game as unknown as { player: Player | null }).player ?? player ?? null;\n        if (pp && boxDist(pp) <= 150) {\n          const d = Math.hypot(this.cx - pp.cx, this.cy - pp.cy) || 1;\n          count++; ux += (this.cx - pp.cx) / d; uy += (this.cy - pp.cy) / d;\n        }\n        if (count > 0) {\n          const zx = (ux / count) * 2, zy = (uy / count) * 2;   // zero/=count; ×2\n          this.vx += zx; this.vy += zy;                        // 对实际速度叠加（:34380）\n          const spd = Math.hypot(this.vx, this.vy);\n          if (spd > 8) { this.vx = (this.vx / spd) * 8; this.vy = (this.vy / spd) * 8; }\n          this.ai2 = 10;                                       // localAI[0]=10 强制重选（:34386）\n        }\n      }\n    } else {\n      // ---- 闪烁发光（:34391-34423）：localAI[2]=发光 / localAI[1]=暗间隔 ----\n      if (this.lai2 > 0) {\n        if (this.lai2 > 3) {\n          const s = this.ai3;\n          this.lightRGB = this.vanillaId === 358 ? [0.10125 * s, 0.21375 * s, 0.225 * s]\n            : this.vanillaId === 654 ? [0.225 * s, 0.105 * s, 0.06 * s]\n              : [0.1095 * s, 0.15 * s, 0.0615 * s];\n        }\n        this.lai2 -= 1;\n      } else if (this.lai1 > 0) {\n        this.lai1 -= 1;\n      } else {\n        this.lai1 = 30 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 150);\n        if (!game.world.clock.isDay || this.cy / TILE > game.world.groundLevel + 10) {\n          this.lai2 = 10 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 20);\n        }\n      }\n    }\n    // ---- 平滑逼近（:34424-34426）----\n    this.vx = (this.vx * 79 + n0) / 80;\n    this.vy = (this.vy * 79 + n1) / 80;\n    // ---- 垂直避障（:34427-34465：中心列逐格，无 break）----\n    const cx = Math.floor(this.cx / TILE), cy = Math.floor(this.cy / TILE);\n    if (this.vy > 0) {\n      for (let j = cy; j < cy + 4; j++) {\n        if (st.inBounds(cx, j) && (st.isSolid(cx, j) || st.liquid[st.idx(cx, j)] > 0)) {\n          n1 = -n1;\n          if (this.vy > 0) this.vy *= 0.9;\n        }\n      }\n    }\n    if (this.vy < 0) {\n      let ground = false;\n      for (let j = cy; j < cy + 30; j++) {\n        if (st.inBounds(cx, j) && st.isSolid(cx, j)) ground = true;\n      }\n      if (!ground) {\n        n1 = -n1;\n        if (this.vy < 0) this.vy *= 0.9;\n      }\n    }\n    const oldVx = this.vx;\n    moveAndCollide(this, game.world, this.vx, this.vy);\n    if (this.hitWall) {\n      // collideX（:34466-34470）：目标翻离墙侧（按 vx 符号），vx×−0.2\n      n0 = this.vx < 0 ?  "new_string": "  /** AI_113 风气球 594（NPC.cs:48253-48430，SetDefaults :16638-16651 noGravity）：\n   *  首帧挂载史莱姆（1/180 金 -4 / 1/10 母 -7 / 1/3 绿 -3，ai[0]=-999 冻结 :61441）\n   *  + TargetClosest 定向一次（:48257——此后不再朝玩家改向，曾逐帧改向）；\n   *  盒 = 20×20×ai[1]（slave scale，:48279-48282 Center 保位改尺寸）。\n   *  瓦片碰撞盒（GetTileCollisionParameters :94013-94018）：x+w/2、y+(44+20×scale)、\n   *  w、h+(44+20×scale)——★只罩吊挂史莱姆区（气球本体不撞墙）。爆条件\n   *  （:48304-48318）：wet（本体或 slave）|| collideX || (collideY 且 oldVy<0=\n   *  撞顶)；落地（collideY 且 oldVy>0）不爆——vy=±1 弹跳沿地面滑行（:48319-48323，\n   *  曾\"嵌实心即爆\"近似）。爆时 X 回退 oldVx+direction×8（本体+slave）、direction\n   *  翻转、vx=direction×2 → 死亡（HitEffect :82590 解冻 slave ai[0]=0 落地开打）。\n   *  横速朝向加速至 2+|wind|×2；前方 8+num3 格探测升降；玩家 400px 内跟随 Y\n   *  （±0.035，同向再 −0.035）。slave 亡 → 自由上飘随风（vy−0.2 钳 ±8、vx+=wind×0.3\n   *  钳 ±4），collideX/Y 即爆 */\n  private windyBalloonAI(game: GameHooks, player: Player | null) {\n    const st = game.world.store;\n    const wind = game.world.weather.windSpeedTarget;\n    if (!this.aiInit) {\n      this.aiInit = true;\n      this.ai2 = 1 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 7); // ai[2] 装饰随机\n      // TargetClosest（:48257，仅此一次——目标中心 X ≥ 本体取 1）\n      if (player && !player.dead) this.facing = player.cx >= this.cx ? 1 : -1;\n      const slave = Enemy.fromVanilla(1, this.cx, this.cy);\n      if (slave) {\n        // 变体覆盖（SetDefaults case -3/:7658、-4/:7668、-7/:7699：\n        // SetDefaults_ForNetId(scale) + 属性/颜色/kbResist 覆写）。\n        // kbResist 乘子（:7665/:7675/:7705）直乘\"承受比例\"（def 已存原版语义）\n        const kbMul = (m: number) => {\n          slave.def.knockbackResist = Math.max(0, slave.def.knockbackResist * m);\n        };\n        const r = Math.random();\n        if (r < 1 / 180) { // 金史莱姆 -4：scale 0.6/dmg 5/def 5/hp 150/kb×1.4\n          //（曾除以已更新的 vanillaScale → 缩放自抵消不缩身，已改同 -7/-3 直乘）\n          slave.w = Math.round(slave.w * 0.6); slave.h = Math.round(slave.h * 0.6);\n          slave.vanillaScale = 0.6;\n          slave.hp = slave.maxHp = 150; slave.def.damage = 5; slave.def.defense = 5;\n          slave.colorRGBA = [250, 30, 90, 90]; kbMul(1.4);\n        } else if (r < 1 / 10) { // 母史莱姆 -7（SetDefaults case -7 :7699：scale 1.2/\n          // damage 12/defense 6/life 40/kbResist×0.9/color 200,0,255,150——曾近似成纯 scale 1.05）\n          slave.vanillaScale = 1.2; slave.w = Math.round(slave.w * 1.2); slave.h = Math.round(slave.h * 1.2);\n          slave.hp = slave.maxHp = 40; slave.def.damage = 12; slave.def.defense = 6;\n          slave.colorRGBA = [200, 0, 255, 150]; kbMul(0.9);\n        } else if (r < 1 / 3) { // 绿史莱姆 -3\n          slave.vanillaScale = 0.9; slave.w = Math.round(slave.w * 0.9); slave.h = Math.round(slave.h * 0.9);\n          slave.hp = slave.maxHp = 14; i < num7 + num8; i++) {\n        if (!st.inBounds(num6, i)) break;\n        const ii = st.idx(num6, i);\n        if (st.isSolid(num6, i) || st.liquid[ii] > 0) {\n          if (i < num7 + 5 + num3) near = true;\n          open = false;\n          break;\n        }\n      }\n      // 目标 400px 内且有视线（cs:48365-48408）→ 跟随 Y：±0.035，且减后仍同号再 ±0.035\n      //（原版两段 if，曾并成单段 0.07 边界不同）；比较位 = Center.Y+h/4 对 position.Y+h/4\n      if (num2 < 400 && player && this.canSeePlayer(st, player)) {\n        const by = this.cy + this.h / 4, py = player.cy - player.h / 4;\n        if (by > py && this.vy > -2) {\n          this.vy -= 0.035;\n          if (this.vy > 0) this.vy -= 0.035;\n        } else if (by < py && this.vy < 2) {\n          this.vy += 0.035;\n          if (this.vy < 0) this.vy += 0.035;\n        }\n      } else {\n        if (open) this.vy += 0.05;  "old_string": "  /** AI_007 小动物行走（NPC.cs:53366+ 的 TownCritter 分支）：站/走循环 + 台阶跳 + 危险逃离。\n   *  速度表（cs:54280-54326）：默认 1/0.07；松鼠族(299/538/539/639-645) 1.5；\n   *  龟(616/617/625) 陆 0.5、水中 2（625 2.5）；鼠类(300/447/610) 2/1 不跳改转身；\n   *  青蛙(361/445/687) 水中 |v|<0.05 时 vx += maxX*10*dir 否则 ×0.9（cs:54333-54342）。\n   *  钉水面（cs:55586-55620 flag12&&wet）：龟/蛙 Center 钉 GetWaterLine 液面（蛙走计时→50）。\n   *  节奏（cs:54030）：站→走 200+rand300+rand(200,400)、走→站 300+rand300-rand100。\n   *  跳跃（cs:54315-54417）：前方 1 格实心+净空 → vy=-5、2 格 → -6、半砖 → -4.4，\n   *  否则危险中 ai0=8 僵立 240t / 平时掉头；上升 ×1.2（非鼠类）。\n   *  危险扫描（cs:53884-54028，每 15t）：200px 内敌怪+视线 → 逃离 120+rand120。\n   *  鸭/海鸥/鷿鷈行走形(362/364/602/608)：wet 或 |vy|>4 → Transform(+1) 飞形（cs:53585） */\n  private townCritterWalkAI(game: GameHooks, player: Player | null) {\n    const st = game.world.store;\n    const vid = this.vanillaId ?? 0;\n    // ---- 松鼠黑化彩蛋（NPC.cs:53797-53812）：CritterThatCanTurnOnPlayers\n    //  （NPCID.cs:4779 = 松鼠 299/红 538/金 539 + 宝石松鼠 639-645）玩家 CanHit\n    //  内 RollOnlyBadLuckExtreme(3000)==0 → ai[3]=2 → lifeMax 25/防+6/伤 20/\n    //  aiStyle=3 反咬（永久转战士；IsThisCenx 彩蛋不移植）----\n    if (CRITTER_TURN_ON_PLAYERS.has(vid)) {\n      if (this.ai3 !== 2 && player && !player.dead\n        && canHit(st, this.x, this.y, this.w, this.h, player.x, player.y, player.w, player.h)\n        && rollOnlyBadLuckExtreme((player as unknown as { luck: number }).luck, 3000) === 0) {\n        this.ai3 = 2;\n      }\n      if (this.ai3 === 2) {\n        if (this.maxHp === 5) {           // lifeMax==5 门（一次性升级）\n          this.maxHp = 25;\n          this.hp = 25;\n          this.def.defense = (this.def.defense ?? 0) + 6;   // defense 可选字段,复合赋值须空合并\n          this.def.damage = 20;\n        }\n        this.fighterAI(game, player);     // aiStyle=3 转战士核\n        return;\n      }\n    }\n    // 687 神秘青蛙点光（NPC.cs:55974-55979：type==683||687 → (0.25,0.25,0.1)×\n    //  Utils.WrappedLerp(0.75,1,t%120/120)；683 黄城镇史莱姆在 TownNPC 桶自报）\n    if (vid === 687) {\n      const p120 = (visEffectFrames() % 120) / 120;\n      const tri = p120 * 2 > 1 ? 2 - p120 * 2 : p120 * 2;\n      const l = 0.75 + 0.25 * tri;\n      this.lightRGB = [0.25 * l, 0.25 * l, 0.1 * l];\n    }\n    if (this.ai0 < 0 || this.ai0 > 8) this.ai0 = 0;\n    if (this.ai1 < 0) this.ai1 = 0;   // 初值 0（原版出生即走;曾 100 站立）\n    const turtle = vid === 616 || vid === 617 || vid === 625;   // 乌龟免危险扫描（:53857/:53881 flag8）\n    // 危险扫描（cs:53884-54028：原版【每 tick】+视线门 CanHit——noTileCollide 族\n    // 豁免;乌龟整段跳过。曾 %15 节流+无视线 = 隔墙也逃,审计 1.2/B-1,2026-08-19）\n    if (!turtle) {\n      for (const o of game.enemies()) {\n        const e = o as Enemy;\n        if (e === this || e.dead || e.def.damage <= 0) continue;\n        if (Math.hypot(e.cx - this.cx, e.cy - this.cy) < 200\n          && canHit(st, this.x, this.y, this.w, this.h, e.x, e.y, e.w, e.h)) {\n          this.ai0 = 1;\n          this.ai1 = 120 + Math.random() * 120;\n          this.facing = e.cx > this.cx ? -1 : 1;\n          break;\n        }\n      }\n    }\n    const inWater = st.liquid[st.idx(Math.floor(this.cx / TILE), Math.floor(this.cy / TILE))] > 80;\n    // 形态链：行走鸭族遇水/坠落 → 飞形（cs:53585-53589）\n    if ((vid === 362 || vid === 364 || vid === 602 || vid === 608) && (inWater || Math.abs(this.vy) > 4)) {\n      this.tryTransformTo(vid + 1, st, false, game);\n      return;\n    }\n    // 速度表\n    const squirrel = vid === 299 || vid === 538 || vid === 539 || (vid >= 639 && vid <= 645);\n    const rat = vid === 300 || vid === 447 || vid === 610;\n    const frog = vid === 361 || vid === 445 || vid === 687;\n    let maxX = 1, acc = 0.07;\n    if (squirrel) maxX = 1.5;\n    else if (turtle) { maxX = inWater ? (vid === 625 ? 2.5 : 2) : 0.5; if (inWater) acc = 1; }\n    else if (rat) { maxX = 2; acc = 1; }\n    // 状态流转\n    this.ai1 -= 1;\n    if (this.ai0 === 0) {\n      this.vx *= 0.8;\n      if (this.ai1 <= 0) { // 站→走（走时长 = 200+rand300+rand(200,400) = 400-899,cs:54160-54166）\n        this.ai0 = 1;\n        this.ai1 = 200 + Math.random() * 300 + 200 + Math.random() * 200;\n        if (Math.random() < 0.5) this.facing *= -1;\n      }\n    } else {\n      this.vx += this.facing * acc;\n      this.vx = Math.max(-maxX, Math.min(maxX, this.vx));\n      // 青蛙水中窜游（cs:54333-54342 flag9&&wet：|vx| 且 |vy| 均 <0.05 才补一窜，否则 ×0.9）\n      if (frog && inWater) {\n        if (Math.abs(this.vx) < 0.05 && Math.abs(this.vy) < 0.05) this.vx += maxX * 10 * this.facing;\n        else this.vx *= 0.9;\n      }\n      if (this.ai1 <= 0) { // 走→站（站时长 = 300+rand300−rand100 = 201-599,cs:54232-54244）\n        this.ai0 = 0;\n        this.ai1 = 300 + Math.random() * 300 - Math.random() * 100;\n        this.vx = 0;\n      }\n    }\n    // 台阶跳跃判定（碰撞前速度符号门略——小动物无冲撞语义）\n    const frontX = Math.floor((this.cx + this.facing * (this.w / 2 + 8)) / TILE);\n    const footY = Math.floor((this.y + this.h - 1) / TILE);\n    if (this.onGround && this.vx !== 0 && st.isSolid(frontX, footY)) {\n      if (rat) { // 鼠类不跳，转身\n        this.facing *= -1;\n        this.vx = 0;\n      } else if (!st.isSolid(frontX, footY - 1) && !st.isSolid(frontX, footY - 2)) {\n        this.vy = -5;\n        this.vy *= 1.2; // TownCritter 上升补偿（cs:54398-54405）\n      } else if (st.isSolid(frontX, footY - 1) && !st.isSolid(frontX, footY - 3)) {\n        this.vy = -6;\n        this.vy *= 1.2;\n      } else {\n        this.facing *= -1; // 跳不过去：掉头\n      }\n    }\n    // ---- 龟/蛙钉水面（cs:55586-55620 flag12&&wet，AI_007 顶层非状态分支）----\n    // flag12 = 龟族(616/617/625) ∪ 蛙族(361/445/687)。湿身时 Center 钉在 GetWaterLine\n    // 线上（Collision.cs:1501，液面 = 行×16 − liquid/16 整除）：线下 → 上浮 0.8 钳 −4\n    // 且不过线（num95=Center+1）；线上 → 只允许落到线。蛙另把走计时砍到 50（连窜）。\n    // 撞墙/贴图边 → 掉头 ×−0.25。无液面可钉（中心上 2 行仍有液=深处/越界）→ vy−0.2。\n    // 重力走原版湿侧（UpdateNPC_UpdateGravity :91936：0.2/落速帽 7）——干侧 0.4 会让\n    // 钉面失衡下沉（0.4−0.2=净沉），此为 GRAVITY 偏差登记的定点补偿\n    const pinSurface = (turtle || frog) && this.wet;\n    this.vy = Math.min(this.vy + (pinSurface ? 0.2 : GRAVITY), pinSurface ? 7 : MAX_FALL_SPEED);\n    if (pinSurface) {\n      if (frog) this.ai1 = 50;\n      const ctx = Math.floor(this.cx / TILE);\n      if (this.hitWall || (ctx < 5 && this.facing === -1) || (ctx > st.w - 5 && this.facing === 1)) {\n        this.facing *= -1;\n        this.vx *= -0.25;\n      }\n      const { found, line } = getWaterLine(st, ctx, Math.floor(this.cy / TILE));\n      if (found) {\n        const anchor = this.cy + 1;                       // num95\n        if (this.cy > line) {\n          this.vy -= 0.8;\n          if (this.vy < -4) this.vy = -4;\n          if (anchor + this.vy < line) this.vy = line - anchor;\n        } else {\n          this.vy = Math.min(this.vy, line - anchor);\n        }\n      } else {\n        this.vy -= 0.2;                                   // 与湿侧重力 0.2 抵消 → 深水中性悬浮\n      }\n    }\n    moveAndCollide(this, game.world, this.vx, this.vy);\n    // （原版行走态无地面摩擦：velocity.X 持续到 cap，仅站立刻车 ±0.1——旧\n    //  `onGround && vx*=0.85` 自创衰减把巡航压到 0.397px/t（稳态 0.07/0.15），\n    //  约为原版 1.0 的一半，已删）\n    if (this.hitWall && !rat) this.facing *= -1;\n  }",
 "new_string": "  /** AI_007 小动物行走（NPC.cs:53366-54711 的 TownCritter 路径，isLikeATownNPC=false\n   *  → 无对话/坐姿/开门/城镇史莱姆支；homeTileY 恒 −1 → flag22 恒 true → StepDown\n   *  永不跑（stepDownGate='never'）、StepUp holdsMatching 恒 true）。\n   *  速度表（cs:54280-54328）：默认 1/0.07；松鼠族(299/538/539/639-645) 1.5；\n   *  龟(616/617/625) 陆 0.5、湿 2/acc1（625 覆写：湿 2.5、干 0.2）；鼠(300/447/610)\n   *  2/1；逃逸/溺水加成（friendly&&(flag16||flag21)，:54322-54328）＝1.5+残血×0.9/0.1\n   *  （覆写族表）。青蛙湿身（:54334-54344）：|v|<0.05 补 maxX×10 一窜，否则 ×0.9\n   *  ——替代常规加速。超帽减速 = 向量 ×0.8（:54345-54351）。\n   *  节奏：站→走 200+Next(300)+Next(200,400)=400-898（:54156-54168，蛙湿身\n   *  700-899 :54049-54056；泡水逃离同式 :54136-54151）；走→站 300+Next(300)−Next(100)\n   *  =201-599（:54232-54244）；走计时溺水冻结（:54216-54231 flag21）+ 离家 >35 格\n   *  逆行每 tick 额外 −5（:54219-54229）。\n   *  台阶跳三档（:54471-54627，★探测行 num27=脚上一行）：t5=num27−2 实心（小个子\n   *  免 t4 联检）→ 后方+前柱净空 → vy=−6（净空堵 → 鼠类查中心前一格实心转身、其余\n   *  掉头/危险僵立）；t4=num27−1 实心 → vy=−5；沉入 >20px 且 num27 非坡实心 →\n   *  vy=−4.4 半砖档；上升 ×1.2（湿身恒乘、TownCritter 非鼠再乘，:54619-54626）。\n   *  跳点回位（:54450-54455）：落地 X 与 localAI[3](跳时 position.X) 相等 → 掉头。\n   *  家域约束（:54179-54202，站立即）：晴日（!flag）或正踩家格 → 超家 25 格外仍\n   *  逆行 50 格回头；家 ±25 格内 1/80 随机翻向（localAI[3]=200 锁）。\n   *  危险扫描（:53884-54028，每 tick）：200px 内敌怪（黑化松鼠族/690 豁免）+CanHit\n   *  → num15 双侧最近者；僵立态背向险 → 复走 300-599；非走态 → 走 120-239 + 背向；\n   *  走态仅调向（不重置计时）。僵立 ai0=8（:54682-54711）：v×0.8 计时归零回站，\n   *  险情续命 180。\n   *  钉水面（cs:55574-55612 flag12&&wet）：龟/蛙 Center 钉 GetWaterLine 液面（蛙走计时→50）。\n   *  鸭/海鸥/鷿鷈行走形(362/364/602/608)：wet（碰撞盒）或 |vy|>4 → Transform(+1) 飞形（cs:53585） */\n  private townCritterWalkAI(game: GameHooks, player: Player | null) {\n    const st = game.world.store;\n    const vid = this.vanillaId ?? 0;\n    // ---- 松鼠黑化彩蛋（NPC.cs:53797-53812）：CritterThatCanTurnOnPlayers\n    //  （NPCID.cs:4779 = 松鼠 299/红 538/金 539 + 宝石松鼠 639-645）玩家 CanHit\n    //  内 RollOnlyBadLuckExtreme(3000)==0 → ai[3]=2 → lifeMax 25/防+6/伤 20/\n    //  aiStyle=3 反咬（永久转战士；IsThisCenx 彩蛋不移植）----\n    if (CRITTER_TURN_ON_PLAYERS.has(vid)) {\n      if (this.ai3 !== 2 && player && !player.dead\n        && canHit(st, this.x, this.y, this.w, this.h, player.x, player.y, player.w, player.h)\n        && rollOnlyBadLuckExtreme((player as unknown as { luck: number }).luck, 3000) === 0) {\n        this.ai3 = 2;\n      }\n      if (this.ai3 === 2) {\n        if (this.maxHp === 5) {           // lifeMax==5 门（一次性升级）\n          this.maxHp = 25;\n          this.hp = 25;\n          this.def.defense = (this.def.defense ?? 0) + 6;   // defense 可选字段,复合赋值须空合并\n          this.def.damage = 20;\n        }\n        this.fighterAI(game, player);     // aiStyle=3 转战士核\n        return;\n      }\n    }\n    // 687 神秘青蛙点光（NPC.cs:55974-55979：type==683||687 → (0.25,0.25,0.1)×\n    //  Utils.WrappedLerp(0.75,1,t%120/120)；683 黄城镇史莱姆在 TownNPC 桶自报）\n    if (vid === 687) {\n      const p120 = (visEffectFrames() % 120) / 120;\n      const tri = p120 * 2 > 1 ? 2 - p120 * 2 : p120 * 2;\n      const l = 0.75 + 0.25 * tri;\n      this.lightRGB = [0.25 * l, 0.25 * l, 0.1 * l];\n    }\n    if (this.ai0 < 0 || this.ai0 > 8) this.ai0 = 0;\n    if (this.ai1 < 0) this.ai1 = 0;   // 初值 0（原版出生即走;曾 100 站立）\n    const turtle = vid === 616 || vid === 617 || vid === 625;   // flag8 乌龟免危险扫描（:53857/:53884）\n    const rat = vid === 300 || vid === 447 || vid === 610;      // flag7 鼠类\n    const frog = vid === 361 || vid === 445 || vid === 687;     // flag9 蛙族\n    const squirrel = vid === 299 || vid === 538 || vid === 539 || (vid >= 639 && vid <= 645);\n    const canBreathe = turtle || frog;   // flag11/flag12：龟蛙水中呼吸（免溺水逃离/钉面）\n    // ---- homeTile 锚（:53683-53699 出生一次：X=出生列,Y 恒 -1）+ FindGoodRestingSpot\n    //  日间 floorX/floorY（:53195-53217：自 home 列下扫首个实心/站台；夜椅搜索未移植）----\n    if (this.critterHomeX === -1) {\n      this.critterHomeX = Math.floor((this.x + this.w / 2) / TILE);\n      if (player && !player.dead && this.facing === 0) {\n        this.facing = player.cx >= this.cx ? 1 : -1;   // TargetClosest（:53685-53695）\n      }\n    }\n    const homeX = this.critterHomeX;\n    let floorY = this.critterHomeY;\n    while (floorY < st.h - 20\n      && !(st.inBounds(homeX, floorY) && (st.isSolid(homeX, floorY) || st.isPlatform(homeX, floorY)))) {\n      floorY++;\n    }\n    // flag（:53383-53399）= 雨天/夜间/日食/史莱姆雨/风暴地表（家域约束的\"晴日\"门）\n    const wthr = game.world.weather;\n    const stormSurface = false;   // Main.IsItStorming 地表门（本仓天气无独立风暴旗）\n    const notCalm = !game.world.clock.isDay || wthr.raining || wthr.slimeRain || stormSurface;\n    const wet = this.wet;         // 原版一律碰撞盒 wet（:54049/:54293/:53585 等，曾中心格 liquid>80）\n    const drowning = !canBreathe\n      && drownCollision(st, this.x, this.y, this.w, this.h, 1);   // flag21（:54216）\n    // ---- 危险扫描（cs:53884-54028，每 tick；乌龟整段跳过）----\n    let danger = false;           // flag16\n    let dangerDir = -1;           // num15：朝最近险情侧\n    if (!turtle) {\n      let leftDelta = -1, rightDelta = -1;   // num13（左侧最近,负）/ num14（右侧最近,正）\n      for (const o of game.enemies()) {\n        const e = o as Enemy;\n        if (e === this || e.dead) continue;\n        const et = e.vanillaId ?? -1;\n        if (CRITTER_TURN_ON_PLAYERS.has(et) || et === 690) continue;   // :53888 豁免源\n        if (e.def.damage <= 0 || e.def.friendly) continue;             // (friendly||damage<=0)&&!stinky\n        if (Math.hypot(e.cx - this.cx, e.cy - this.cy) >= 200) continue;   // num11/num12 均 200\n        if (!e.noTileCollide\n          && !canHit(st, this.x, this.y, this.w, this.h, e.x, e.y, e.w, e.h)) continue;\n        danger = true;\n        const dx = e.cx - this.cx;\n        if (dx < 0 && (leftDelta === -1 || dx > leftDelta)) leftDelta = dx;\n        if (dx > 0 && (rightDelta === -1 || dx < rightDelta)) rightDelta = dx;\n      }\n      if (danger) {\n        // num15（:53959）：右侧更近取 1 否则 −1\n        dangerDir = leftDelta === -1 ? 1\n          : rightDelta !== -1 ? (rightDelta < -leftDelta ? 1 : -1) : -1;\n        if (this.ai0 === 8) {\n          // 僵立背向险情 → 复走（:53969-53978）\n          if (this.facing === -dangerDir) {\n            this.ai0 = 1;\n            this.ai1 = 300 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 300);\n            this.ai2 = 0;\n            this.lai3 = 0;\n          }\n        } else if (this.ai0 !== 1) {\n          // 非走态 → 起步逃离（:54007-54019；TownCritter 的 avoidFalling 恒 false）\n          this.ai0 = 1;\n          this.ai1 = 120 + Math.random() * 120;\n          this.ai2 = 0;\n          this.lai3 = 0;\n          this.facing = -dangerDir;\n        } else if (this.facing !== -dangerDir) {\n          this.facing = -dangerDir;   // 走态仅调向,不重置计时（:54022-54026）\n        }\n      }\n    }\n    // 形态链：行走鸭族湿身/坠落 → 飞形（cs:53585-53589，|vy|>4 或 wet）\n    if ((vid === 362 || vid === 364 || vid === 602 || vid === 608) && (wet || Math.abs(this.vy) > 4)) {\n      this.tryTransformTo(vid + 1, st, false, game);\n      return;\n    }\n    if (this.ai0 === 0) {\n      // ---- 站立（:54103-54202）----\n      if (this.lai3 > 0) this.lai3 -= 1;                    // :54040-54042\n      if (frog && wet) {\n        // 蛙湿身起走（:54049-54056，200+Next(500,700)=700-899）\n        this.ai0 = 1;\n        this.ai1 = 200 + 500 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 200);\n        this.ai2 = 0;\n        this.lai3 = 0;\n      } else {\n        if (rat) this.vx *= 0.5;                            // :54105-54108\n        if (this.vx > 0.1) this.vx -= 0.1;                  // ±0.1 线性刹车（:54109-54120）\n        else if (this.vx < -0.1) this.vx += 0.1;\n        else this.vx = 0;\n        if (this.ai1 > 0) this.ai1 -= 1;\n        const startWalk = (): void => {\n          this.ai0 = 1;\n          this.ai1 = 200 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 300)\n            + 200 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 200);        // 400-898（:54161-54166）\n          this.ai2 = 0;\n          this.lai3 = 0;\n        };\n        if (wet && !canBreathe && drowning) {\n          startWalk();                                       // 泡水逃离（:54136-54151）\n        } else if (this.ai1 <= 0) {\n          startWalk();\n        }\n      }\n      // ---- 家域约束（:54179-54202，仅站立态）----\n      const num6 = Math.floor((this.x + this.w / 2) / TILE);\n      const num7 = Math.floor((this.y + this.h + 1) / TILE);\n      // IsInAGoodRestingSpot（:53165-53183）：蛙湿身恒否；余 = 正踩 (floorX,floorY)\n      const atRest = !((vid === 361 || vid === 445 || vid === 687) && wet)\n        && num6 === homeX && num7 === floorY;\n      if (!notCalm || atRest) {\n        if (num6 < homeX - 25 || num6 > homeX + 25) {\n          if (this.lai3 === 0) {\n            if (num6 < homeX - 50 && this.facing === -1) this.facing = 1;\n export function updateNpcLiquid(b: NpcLiquidHost, game: GameHooks, st: TileStore): void {
  const player = (game as unknown as { player: Player }).player;
  // ---- 1. 岩浆（Collision_LavaCollision :94513）----
  if (b.lavaCd > 0) b.lavaCd--;
  let lava = liquidCollision(st, b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h, 2);
  if (b.vanillaId === 441) lava = false;                  // :94515 type 441 强制豁免
  if (lava) {
    // lavaImmune 只免伤不免 lavaWet（:94524 置位在 !lavaImmune 门之外）——
    // 免疫族入浆同样走岩浆减速档且不熄火
    b.lavaWet = true;
    // 金属矿史莱姆状态位（NPC.cs:61109：type 1 携 364/1104/365/1105/366/1106 矿 →
    // lavaImmune=true，非 SetDefaults 表内——按 ai[1] 状态求值）
    const metalOre = b.vanillaId === 1
      && (b.ai1 === 364 || b.ai1 === 1104 || b.ai1 === 365
        || b.ai1 === 1105 || b.ai1 === 366 || b.ai1 === 1106);
    const lavaImmune = metalOre || (b.vanillaId !== null && NPC_LAVA_IMMUNE.has(b.vanillaId));
    if (!lavaImmune && b.lavaCd <= 0) {
      b.lavaCd = 30;                                      // immune[255] = 30（:94527）
      b.onFireT = Math.max(b.onFireT, 7);                 // AddBuff(24, 420)
      b.hurt(50, 0, 0, game);                             // StrikeNPCNoInteraction(50)
      game.spawnParticles(b.cx, b.cy, '#FF9A3C', 10, 1.6, { life: 30, grav: -0.05 });
    }
  }

  // ---- 2. 水湿（Collision_WaterCollision :94250）----
  const skip = skipsWet(b);
  let flag = false;
  if (skip) {
    b.wetCount = 0;
  } else {
    const r = wetCollision(st, b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h);
    flag = r.wet;
    // 原版只置 true 不清零（:94265-94272），清位统一在 !wet 段（:93729-93732，
    // 在本函数步骤 3）——出水 tick 的湿型残留旗（Splash_5 出水微光档）依赖此序
    if (r.honey) b.honeyWet = true;
    if (r.shimmer) b.shimmerWet = true;
  }
  const wasWet = b.wet;
  if (flag && !wasWet && b.wetCount === 0) {
    b.wetCount = 10;                                      // 入水去抖（:94290）
    if (player && !player.dead && splashSoundAllowed(b, true)) {
      // 按液体选 wav（:94296-94310 水 0/蜜 1/微光 4/岩浆 1）；Sfx.atten 统一 2500px 衰减
      game.playSfxWav?.(splashWavFile(b, true, lava), b.def.boss ? 1.2 : 0.9, b.cx, b.cy);
    }
  } else if (!flag && wasWet) {
    b.vx *= 0.5;                                          // 出水横向衰减（:94381）
    if (b.vanillaId === 620 && player && player.cy < b.cy) b.vy -= 8; // :94384
    if (b.wetCount === 0) {
      b.wetCount = 10;                                    // 出水去抖（:94388）
      if (player && !player.dead && splashSoundAllowed(b, false)) {
        // 出水档微光 = style 5（:94429）——与入水 4 不对称,原版如此
        game.playSfxWav?.(splashWavFile(b, false, lava), b.def.boss ? 1.2 : 0.9, b.cx, b.cy);
      }
    }
  }
  b.wet = flag;
  // ---- 3. !wet 清液体类型态（:93729-93733）----
  if (!b.wet) {
    b.lavaWet = false;
    b.honeyWet = false;
    b.shimmerWet = false;
  }
  // ---- 4. 入水熄火（TryRemovingWaterPerishableEffects :94537，门 = flag 且非岩浆）----
  if (flag && !lava) {
    b.onFireT = 0;                                        // DelBuff(24)
    b.onFire3T = 0;                                       // DelBuff(323)
  }
  if (b.wetCount > 0) b.wetCount--;                       // :93734
  b.inWater = b.wet;                                      // 兼容旧字段
  // ---- 5. 移动积分因子（:93748-93762 优先级链）----
  b.liqFactor = liquidMoveFactor(b);
  // ---- 6. wet 落速帽（UpdateNPC_UpdateGravity :91936-91944）----
  // 原版 wet 时重力 0.3→0.2 且 maxFallSpeed 10→7（蜂蜜 0.1/4、微光 0.15/5.5；
  // 岩浆走水档 else 分支）。本仓各 AI 内联 GRAVITY=0.4（全仓既有偏差，不逐点改），
  // 这里补落速帽——配合 liqFactor ×0.5 位移后有效下沉 ≤3.5px/t，与原版同档
  if (b.wet) {
    const cap = b.shimmerWet ? 5.5 : b.honeyWet ? 4 : 7;
    if (b.vy > cap) b.vy = cap;
  }
}

- **金鱼链位置**：Enemy 新增公共方法 `fishTransformationDuringRain`，Game.ts 敌怪轮（`entities.update` 之后）逐敌调用——wet 为本 tick 新值，与原版 UpdateCollision :93742（wet 计算后、位移积分前）等价；不与 55↔230 既有逻辑冲突（MechSpawn 计数豁免对 :13121 原样，swimAI noChase 五族含 55/592 未动）。

- **原版怪癖核证**：西向钳位不对称（1456:54363 与 1405:20170 双版一致）；StepUp 卡墙折返探测器按仓内 TownNPC 既有解释（X 无位移=卡墙）承接；气球扩展碰撞盒字面移植。
